# POLYMAZE-Champions-League

> Draw page for the POLYMAZE robotics competition. Enter 12 team names in two tiers (or import them), run the draw, and get league-phase fixtures with maze assignments and a schedule. No build step.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/puIad/POLYMAZE-Champions-League/blob/main/README.md): how to use it

## Source

- [app.js](https://github.com/puIad/POLYMAZE-Champions-League/blob/main/app.js): draw, maze assignment and schedule logic
- [index.html](https://github.com/puIad/POLYMAZE-Champions-League/blob/main/index.html): screens
- [styles.css](https://github.com/puIad/POLYMAZE-Champions-League/blob/main/styles.css): styles
- [Design-System](https://github.com/puIad/POLYMAZE-Champions-League/tree/main/Design-System): brand assets
